_about: Who is on screen. brand/pick_cast.py gives every video of the week one person from this list, matched to the group's persona, mixing relatable and aspirational, never the same person twice in a group and not reused from the last two weeks. The brief writes that person as ACTOR A in every row. Source: the team's persona DB and purchaser overlay (spry-creative-system analysis/persona-db-team_codified.md, owner-adopted 2026-08-06): casting band F40-49, gender about 50/50, US Sunbelt homes; the material-skeptic lanes keep M45-54. Relatable = looks like the buyer today, real and lived-in. Aspirational = who the buyer wants to become: put together, confident, at ease in a finished home; still a real person, never a model look.

personas._rule: persona code -> pool. Codes not listed use their family's default below, then 'everyday'.
